# northflank_project (Data Source)

Looks up a Northflank project by name. When `team_id` is provided the search is scoped to that team's projects (required for multi-team configurations). Use the resulting `id` as `project_id` in `northflank_secret` resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_team" "main" {
  name = "Acme Engineering"
}

data "northflank_project" "api" {
  name    = "api-service"
  team_id = data.northflank_team.main.id
}

output "project_id" {
  value = data.northflank_project.api.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project to look up.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) ID of the team to scope the search to. Obtain this from a `northflank_team` data source. When omitted, searches projects accessible to the token's implicit team.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `id` (String) Project identifier.
